user.title: Enova Power
user.description: Sign in with your Enova Power My Account credentials. This is an unofficial integration, not affiliated with Enova Power Corp.

data_description.backfill_months: How many months of past usage to download on first setup. The portal may keep less; older costs are estimated at today's rates. To import more later, run the Backfill history action.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Enova Power
reauth_confirm.description: Your Enova Power credentials need updating.

error.no_meter: Signed in, but no meter was found. The portal may be blocking logins after too many attempts; wait at least 5 minutes and try again.

abort.account_mismatch: The credentials are for a different Enova Power account

init.title: Enova Power options
init.description: Your plan is detected automatically from your account — set it here only to override a wrong or missing detection. Cost is estimated from the energy line item only (excludes delivery, regulatory charges, rebates and tax) and is currently computed for Time-of-Use and Tiered.

backfill.name: Backfill history
backfill.description: Re-imports the account's usage for the last given number of months from the portal, in the background. Stored history outside that range is kept. Older costs are estimated at today's rates, and the total consumption sensor jumps by any newly imported history.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: The Enova Power account to backfill.

months.name: Months
months.description: How far back to import. Defaults to the depth chosen at setup.

entry_not_found.message: No Enova Power account found for that entry.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Enova Power account is not loaded.
